nodes.rationale: The pot is a passbook: every coin movement is a dated printed line with debit, credit and saldo; balance is always the sum of lines above. Chosen as candidate 3 of 7 grounded forms.

nodes.norm_label: root package.json bun scripts (infra:up, codegen, dev:*, test, lint, deploy:*)
nodes.rationale: Bun is cross-platform so the same commands work on Windows without make.

nodes.label: garage:init bootstrap script (scripts/garage-init.ts)
nodes.rationale: Garage image has no shell, so bootstrap is an idempotent Bun script via docker compose exec.

nodes.label: STORAGE_DRIVER=fs (native mode)
nodes.rationale: Garage has no Windows build.

nodes.label: Docker mount rules (RUNNING §4)
nodes.rationale: Bind mounts on Windows break Postgres permissions and risk corruption; host node_modules are not Linux binaries.

nodes.label: BlobStore Interface (s3 and fs drivers)
nodes.rationale: fs driver enables no-Docker mode with HMAC-signed local URLs; not for production

nodes.label: domain package (pure, no I/O)
nodes.rationale: 100% unit-testable; terms validation, NextStatus FSM, penalty clamp, deadline computation

nodes.label: service package (use-cases, tx boundaries)
nodes.rationale: Each transition (SubmitProof, Approve, Reject, Dispute, ResolveDispute, Override, DeclareRest, SweepDeadlines) is a single function used by API and worker

nodes.label: UPLOAD_MODE=proxy fallback
nodes.rationale: Fallback if Garage does not enforce signed Content-Length (TestPresignedPutRejectsWrongLength)

nodes.label: ADR-0006 PostgreSQL with sqlc and goose
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006 postgresql with sqlc and goose
nodes.rationale: No ORM so money and time logic stays visible SQL

nodes.label: ADR-0008 Three Run Modes via Bun Scripts
nodes.norm_label: adr-0008 three run modes via bun scripts
nodes.rationale: Windows dev often lacks make; Bun is required anyway and cross-platform

nodes.label: Backend Layering (http/jobs -> service -> domain/store)
nodes.rationale: Dependencies point downward only; one implementation per transition shared by API and worker

nodes.label: redis:8 service (AOF)
nodes.rationale: AOF keeps queued asynq tasks across restarts (ADR-0004).
